Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:1.hebrew: מוגמר וגפרית מ"ט שרו - הא מנחי בכלים:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:1.english: Incense and sulfur, what is the reason [Beit Shammai] permitted [them] - Aren't they placed in vessels?

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:2.english: For example, where the incense and sulfur are placed on the ground - And not in a vessel.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:3.hebrew: גיגית - שהשכר בתוכו, ואי אפשר לשופכו לארץ, והשעורין נשורין כל השבת — יותר מח' ימים, והשבת בכלל; וכן נר הדולק בשבת; וכן קדרה שעל גבי כירה, שאי אפשר שלא תצטמק בשבת; וכן שפוד המונח בתנור, כדתנן (דף יט:) משלשלין את הפסח, ולא פליגי ב"ש:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:3.english: A tub - For the beer is inside it, and it is impossible to pour it onto the ground, and the barley is soaking throughout Shabbat — more than eight days, and Shabbat is included [among them]; and similarly, a lamp that burns on Shabbat; and similarly, a pot upon a stove, which cannot but simmer down on Shabbat; and similarly, a spit placed in an oven, as we learned in a mishnah (daf 19b): "They lower the Paschal offering," and Beit Shammai do not disagree.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:4.hebrew: בדמפקר להו - לכלים, ושוב אינו מצווה על שביתתן:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:1:4.english: In [a case] where he declares them ownerless - [That is,] the vessels, and he is then no longer commanded regarding their resting.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:2:1.hebrew: עססיות ותורמסין - מיני קטניות, וצריכין בישול יותר:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:2:1.english: Asasiyyot and lupines - [They are] types of legumes, and they require more cooking.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:2:2.english: For [the time] sufficient for them to be prepared - So that he will not benefit from labor [performed on] Shabbat.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:2:3.english: He will stoke the coals - To speed up their cooking.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:1.hebrew: סליק בהו קוטרא - של עצים, ומשחיר הבגדים, ועשן העצים קשה להם. וכן בגפרית:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:1.english: Smoke will rise into them - [The smoke] of wood, and it blackens the garments, and the smoke of the wood is damaging to them. And likewise with sulfur.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:2.hebrew: לא מגלי - משטח פי תנור, וליכא למגזר שמא יחתה בגחלים:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:2.english: He does not uncover - The covering of the mouth of the oven, and there is no [reason] to decree lest he stoke the coals.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:3.english: Let [the Sages] issue a decree - Lest he stoke the coals.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:5.hebrew: מגיס - מהפך בה, ובמבושל הוי בישול:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:5.english: Stirs - [He] turns [the contents] over in it, and in [the case of that which is being] cooked, [this] constitutes cooking.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:6.hebrew: וטוחה - מכוסה בכיסוי שלה, וטוחה בטיט סביב, דכולי האי לא טרח, ומידכר:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:3:6.english: And sealed - Covered with its lid and plastered with clay all around, for he would not go to all that trouble [inadvertently], and he will remember [that it is Shabbat].

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:4:1.english: And now that the Master said - That placing a pot is not prohibited except because of stoking [the coals].

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:4:2.hebrew: האי קדר' חייתא שפיר דמי - להשהותה לכתחלה מבעוד יום בתנור, והיא מתבשלת כל הלילה. דודאי חייתא לאו אדעתא למיכלה לאורתא אנחה התם, ומשום למחר לא אתי לחתויי, שהרי יש לה שהות גדול. ולא דמי לעססיות ותורמסין, שאין כל הלילה והיום די להן:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:4:2.english: This pot of raw [meat] is permitted - To leave it at the outset while it is still day in the oven, and it cooks the entire night. For certainly, [since it is] raw, he did not place it there with the intention of eating it at night; and on account of tomorrow, he will not come to stoke [the coals], for behold, it has ample time [to cook]. And it is not similar to *asasyot* and lupines, as the entire night and day are not sufficient for them.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:4:3.hebrew: ובשיל שפיר דמי - מבושלת כל צרכה, שפיר דמי להניחה, דלא בעי חיתוי:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:4:3.english: And [if it is] cooked, it is permitted - [If it is] fully cooked, it is permitted to place it [in the oven], as it does not require stoking [the coals].

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:4:4.english: [If] he threw a raw bone into it - For it is not his intention to eat it in the evening.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:1.english: A kid - Wind is harmful to it.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:2.hebrew: שריק - פי התנור בטיט סביב כיסוי, אינו מוכן לחתות:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:2.english: Sealed - [The] opening of the oven [is sealed] with clay around [the] cover, [so] he is not poised to stoke [the coals].

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:3.hebrew: ברחא - איל גדול. לא קשיא ליה זיקא, ואתי לגלויי פי התנור, ליטול כיסויו לחתות:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:3.english: A ram - A large ram. Wind is not harmful to it, and he may come to uncover the mouth of the oven, removing its cover to stoke [the coals].

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:4.hebrew: דגדיא ולא שריק - איכא חדא לאיסורא, וחדא להיתרא:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:5:4.english: [Meat] of a kid and not sealed - There is one [factor] for prohibition and one for permission.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:6:1.hebrew: בבשרא אגומרי - שאינו בתנור, דאפילו כיסוי ליכא, ומוכן להפוך בו ולחתות:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:6:1.english: [In the case of] meat on the coals - Which is not in an oven, for there is not even a cover, and [one is] prone to turn it over and stoke [the coals].

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:1.hebrew: לא ישאלנו - שאלה — דבר החוזר בעין; הלואה — בדבר הניתן להוצאה:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:1.english: Nor lend [it] to him - Lending [applies to] an object that returns in its original form, [whereas] loaning [is] with regard to an item given to be spent.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:2.hebrew: אלא כדי שיגיע - הנכרי לביתו מבעוד יום. ואע"ג דבדידיה קטרח, מחמירין ב"ש דמיחלף בשלוחו:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:2.english: Unless [there is sufficient time] for him to reach - [That is, for] the gentile [to reach] his house while it is still day. And even though he is toiling for himself, Beit Shammai are stringent, lest he be mistaken for his agent.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:3.hebrew: בית הסמוך לחומה - של עיר אחרת שהנכרי דר שם, שהרי יכול להניחו שם:
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:3.english: The house adjacent to the wall - Of another city where the gentile lives, for he can leave it there.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:4.english: From the entrance of his house - Of the Jew.

Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:5.hebrew: הן הן דברי כו' - לא בא ר"ע לחלוק על ב"ה, אלא לחלוק על תנא בן מחלוקתו, שאמר אליבא דב"ה לבית הסמוך לחומה. ובא ר"ע לומר: לא אמרו ב"ה כן, אלא כו':
Rashi on Shabbat 18b:7:5.english: That is the statement of, etc. - Rabbi Akiva did not come to disagree with Beit Hillel, but to disagree with the Tanna who is his disputant, who said according to Beit Hillel: “[Until he reaches] the house adjacent to the wall.” And Rabbi Akiva came to say: Beit Hillel did not say so, but rather, etc.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:1:1.hebrew: דמפקרא להו אפקורי - אע"ג דאמר בנדרים (דף מה.) דבעינן הפקר בפני ג' — הכא לא בעינן, דמסתמא מפקיר להו. ואין לסמוך על זה להשכיר סוס לנכרי ולהפקיר, דהכא שאני, משום דלא אפשר בענין אחר, ועוד שאין הדבר מפורסם:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:1:1.english: "Where he declares them ownerless" - Even though [the Gemara] says in Nedarim (45a) that we require declaration of ownerlessness [to be made] in the presence of three [people], here we do not require [this], for presumably he declares them ownerless. And one cannot rely on this to rent a horse to a non-Jew and declare [it] ownerless, for here it is different, because it is not possible [to do so] in any other way, and furthermore because the matter is not publicized.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:2:1.hebrew: לא ימלא נחתום כו' - כדמסיק: גזירה שמא יחתה. אף ע"פ שיש שהות הרבה להתחמם, חיישינן שמא יצטנן — לפי שרגילים לחמם על אש רפה, ויהא צריך לחתות:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:2:1.english: "A baker may not fill, etc." - As [the Gemara] concludes: [It is] a decree lest he stoke [the coals]. Even though there is ample time for [the water] to heat up, we are concerned lest it cool down, since they are accustomed to heat [it] over a low fire, and he will need to stoke [the coals].

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:2:2.hebrew: גזירה שמא יחתה - ואם תאמר: מעיקרא, דלא ידע האי טעמא, תקשי ליה מתני' דבשר, בצל וביצה, וחררה? ויש לומר: דהתם ידע שפיר דהוי טעמא משום שמא יחתה, שאין דבר מפסיק בינו לגחלים:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:2:2.english: "A decree lest he stoke [the coals]" - And if you say: Initially, when [the questioner] did not know this reason, shouldn't the Mishnah of meat, an onion, an egg, and a cake [chararah] pose a difficulty to him? And one can say: There, he knew well that the reason is due to [the concern] lest he stoke [the coals], since there is nothing separating between it [the food] and the coals.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:3:1.hebrew: ביורה עקור' וטוחה - ואין לחוש שמא יגלה ויגיס, שאין דרך להגיס כמו לחתות; ועוד, דשמא מיהדק טפי:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:3:1.english: "In a kettle [that is] removed and sealed" - And we need not be concerned lest he uncover [it] and stir [it], for it is not customary to stir as [it is] to stoke [coals]; and furthermore, [because] perhaps it is fastened more tightly.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:3:2.english: "Lest he stir in it" - And [this] constitutes dyeing.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:4:1.hebrew: בשיל ולא בשיל אסור - צ"ל דלא הוי כמאכל בן דרוסאי; דאי הוה כמאכל בן דרוסאי — שרי להשהותו על גבי כירה, אע"פ שאינה גרופה וקטומה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:4:1.english: “[Meat that is] cooked and not [sufficiently] cooked is prohibited” - It must be said that it has not [even reached the level of] the food of Ben Derusai; for if it were [cooked like] the food of Ben Derusai, it would be permitted to leave it on a stove even though it is neither swept nor covered with ashes.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:5:1.hebrew: האי בישרא דגדיא ושריק - מפרש בה"ג דמכאן ואילך איירי בצלי. וכן משמע מדמייתי עלה: "אין צולין בשר בצל וביצה", ולקמן בפרקין נמי מייתי לה אמשלשלים את הפסח. ולהכי ברחא ולא שריק אסור אפי' בחייא — כיון דמיירי בצלי, ראוי לאוכלה בלילה, ואתי לחתויי:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:5:1.english: "This meat of a kid and [the oven is] sealed" - The Ba'al Halakhot Gedolot explains that from here on, [the Gemara] is dealing with roast [meat]. And so it is implied from the fact that [the Gemara] cites concerning it: "One may not roast meat, an onion, and an egg," and later in our chapter [19b] it also cites this regarding [the Mishnah]: "They lower the Paschal offering [into the oven]." And therefore, [the meat of] a ram and [the oven is] not sealed is forbidden even when raw; since [the Gemara] is dealing with roast [meat], it is fit to be eaten at night, and he will come to stoke [the coals].

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:6:1.hebrew: התם בבשרא אגומרי - וא"ת: לרב אשי דשרי ברחא ולא שריק, ולא אסר אלא בשרא אגומרי — תיקשי ליה מתני' דאין נותנין הפת בתוך התנור (דף יט.)! ועוד, "משלשלין את הפסח" אמרי': מאי טעמא? משום דבני חבורה זריזין הן, כדמפרש לקמן (שבת דף כ:); והא בלאו הכי נמי שרי! ויש לומר: דמיירי שהתנור פתוח, דהוי כמו בשרא אגומרי. ונראה דאין הלכה כרב אשי בהאי לישנא דשרי ברחא ולא שריק; דסוגיא דלעיל, דקאמר: "כיון דקשי ליה זיקא לא מגלה לה", לא אתיה כוותיה; וכן סוגיא דלקמן גבי בני חבורה דזריזין הם, דמשני: "האי מנתח" — פי': וקשי ליה זיקא — "והאי לא מנתח"; ולרב אשי, אפי' היכא דלא קשי ליה זיקא שרי:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:6:1.english: "There, [it is referring to] meat on the coals" - And if you say: According to Rav Ashi, who permits [meat of] a ram [in an oven that is] not sealed, and only prohibits meat on the coals, the Mishnah [which states] that "one may not place bread into an oven" (19b) should pose a difficulty to him! And furthermore, [regarding the rule that] "one may lower the Paschal lamb [into the oven with nightfall]," we say: What is the reason? "Because the members of the group are vigilant," as [the Gemara] explains below (Shabbat 20a); but even without this [vigilance], it should also be permitted [according to Rav Ashi]! And one can say: [There,] it is dealing with [a case where] the oven is open, which is [equivalent to] meat on the coals. And it appears that the halakhah does not follow Rav Ashi according to this version, which permits [meat of] a ram [in an oven that is] not sealed; for the sugya above, which states, "Since the wind is damaging for it, he will not uncover it," does not accord with his view; and similarly, the sugya below regarding the members of the group who are vigilant, where [the Gemara] answers: "This is cut into pieces" — explanation: and [therefore] wind is damaging for it — "and that is not cut into pieces"; whereas according to Rav Ashi, even where wind is not damaging for it, it is permitted.

Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:7:1.hebrew: ולא ישאילנו כו' אלא כדי שיגיע לביתו - לא מיירי בכלים, דאסור לב"ש משום שביתת כלים, דאפילו ברביעי או בחמישי נמי; אלא כגון חלוק ושאר דברים. וטעמא משום הוצאה, ונראה כשלוחו, כדפ"ה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 18b:7:1.english: "Nor lend it to him, etc., unless [there is sufficient time] for him to reach his house" - [The baraita] is not dealing with utensils, for [lending those] is forbidden according to Beit Shammai due to the resting of utensils, as [in that case it would be forbidden] even on Wednesday or Thursday as well; rather, [it is dealing with items] such as a tunic and other items. And the reason [here] is due to carrying, and [because the gentile] appears like his agent, as the Kunteres [Rashi] explained.
